subject: Dedicated capacity demo request: QueueLogic throughput & latency
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@queuelogic.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo – high throughput evaluation

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick sign-up form — I'm Samira (Head of ML Ops at QueueLogic). We're evaluating dedicated-serving options for a conversational recommender and would like a focused walk-through on Redwood Dedicated. High-level requirements: 

- Sustained traffic: ~200 requests/sec (average), with peaks up to ~400 RPS for short bursts
- 99th percentile tail latency target: <200ms (token-level latency matters)
- Model family: ~70B dense model (we can provide the architecture and sample weights for local profiling)
- Typical request length: 1k tokens; responses ~200-400 tokens

I've attached a short workload summary (workload_summary.csv) and a simple diagram of our infra. Ideal next step would be a demo + a short scoped load test on a dedicated pool so we can validate latency and throughput. We have availability next week in the mornings (PST).

Could you propose a 60–90 minute slot and a pre-demo checklist? Also please confirm any NDA/PO steps required before a pilot.

Thanks,
Samira
Head of ML Ops, QueueLogic
attachments: workload_summary.csv
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@queuelogic.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity demo – high throughput evaluation

Hi Samira — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the summary; that's a clear starting point.

We can definitely run a focused session to validate throughput and tail latency on a Dedicated pool. Proposed next steps (quick):

1) 30–60 min pre-demo sync to confirm benchmarks, dataset access, and network steps
2) 60–90 min demo + live load test (we'll coordinate a short ramp and a steady-state run)
3) Optional reserved-capacity pilot (2–4 weeks) if results look good

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 9/15 10:00–11:30
- Thu 9/16 10:00–11:30

Quick clarification items for us before the pre-demo call:
- Can you confirm whether inference will be in a VPC (private) or via public API?
- Any IP allowlist restrictions we should prepare for?
- Will you be providing a representative dataset and a sample model binary, or should we run with a model variant from our catalog?

Ben (cc) is our SDR coordinating logistics; Neha will help on the pre-demo config and ops checklist. I'll attach a one-page scheduling options doc and our high-level demo playbook after this message.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks — Wed 9/15 10:00–11:30 PST works for us. Please invite Samira Khan (me), Alex Perez (backend lead, alex.perez@queuelogic.com), and ops@queuelogic.com.

A couple of clarifications we can answer before the pre-demo call:

- We'll provide a small representative dataset and model checkpoint (sftp link) before the run.
- For the live run let's plan: 10m ramp, 20m steady at 400 RPS peak bursts, then a short stress burst. Goal is to observe 99th tail at target below 200ms.

Thanks for confirming and for the diagram. Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP-QueueLogic-QL-20260914.pdf) and our pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.md). Key items for your team before the demo:

- Provide sftp link to sample model/checkpoint and a small labeled query set (we'll use it for warmup & KV cache priming)
- Provide source IPs for allowlist or confirm VPC peering plan; if peering isn't possible we can route via an egress IP set
- Confirm whether telemetry/tracing endpoints are acceptable to be forwarded to our temporary observability tenant or if you want to ingest into your own monitoring
- If you want to test quantized variants, let us know which precision (int8/int4) you want us to try during the run

We will:
- Provision a temporary dedicated pool sized for a 70B-class model and prepare a short workload runner for the ramp/steady/stress phases
- Share a Zoom link + calendar invite once Ben confirms attendee list

Attachments: MAP-QueueLogic-QL-20260914.pdf, pre-demo-checklist.md

- For a short reserved-capacity pilot (2–4 weeks), we'll need a signed SOW or PO. I've shared a DocuSign for an NDA/PO in the related links.
- If the demo validates performance we can propose a canary rollout: start with a small reserved pool and scale by traffic tiers to meet peak. That reduces risk while we validate QoS.
